plan: Hold workspace state as one canonical dictionary, deep-copied on construction and again on to_data(), so external mutation can never leak in or out.
Implement a single recursive depth-first locator that yields (parent_list, index, item) for any id; every public operation reuses it so containment rules live in one place.

Aggregate total_word_count and unresolved_markers with a kind-dispatched traversal: notes are processed with two compiled regexes (markers stripped first, then \b\w+\b counted), references contribute declared word_count and unresolved entries.
Render outline() by appending the workspace title, then walking items depth-first, emitting two spaces per nesting level plus 'kind: title'.

Structure move() as validate-before-mutate: check id types, resolve source and destination, reject non-container destinations, reject self/descendant containment via a descendant-id set, and range-check the insertion index — all before the pop/insert pair, guaranteeing failed moves leave the data byte-identical.
mechanisms: Canonical deep-copied dict state with copy.deepcopy at both construction and export boundaries
Recursive DFS locator returning (parent_list, index, item) shared by all operations
Compiled regex pair: marker token pattern [[?\w+]] and word pattern \b\w+\b, with marker stripping before word counting
Descendant-id set computed pre-mutation for self/cycle containment rejection
Validate-before-mutate protocol in move() ensuring atomicity of failure
